advisor.settings.title: Advisor
advisor.settings.desc: Set the advisor mode, route, budgets and privacy. Saved changes apply to the next consultation.
advisor.settings.mode.offHint: Never consult the advisor and never spend.
advisor.settings.mode.shadowHint: Record only, never feed back to the model: the advisor is still called and logged, but its advice never enters the model context.
advisor.settings.mode.advisoryHint: Normal consultation: advice returns to the model context as a tool card the model may follow or ignore.
advisor.settings.provider.none: The host returned no routes (llm service unavailable?)
advisor.settings.provider.stale: (current value is not in the route list)
advisor.settings.model.manualHint: Type an id if it is not listed; manual ids are not checked against the catalog.
advisor.settings.model.none: This route lists no models — type one manually
advisor.settings.model.stale: (current value is not in the model list)
advisor.settings.effort.none: This model declares no reasoning efforts
advisor.settings.effort.stale: (current value is not declared by the model)
advisor.settings.postAnswer.hint: In advisory mode, run the advisor once after each turn; record only, never feed back.
advisor.settings.advisorToolsHint: Let the advisor request files inside the working directory (≤5 files, ≤64 KiB, read-only) to verify its conclusions; costs one extra model call.
advisor.settings.budget.workspaceHint: Workspace-wide: shared across sessions, resets on the local day
advisor.settings.scope.summaryHint: Send only the host-injected 300-character context (no file bodies).
advisor.settings.scope.fullHint: Send the full context, truncated to maxInputChars.
advisor.settings.privacy.redactHint: Best-effort pattern replacement, not a secret scanner; leaks are still possible.
advisor.settings.privacy.dedupeHint: Affects the shadow path only: identical advice is not recorded twice.
advisor.settings.advanced.temperatureHint: Empty = not sent, decided by the adapter · range 0–2
advisor.settings.advanced.allowedModelsHint: Empty = no limit; accepts provider/model or a bare model id
advisor.settings.preview.title: Preview
advisor.settings.confirm.hint: Add the current provider to the confirmed list so cross-provider consultations stop being interrupted.
advisor.settings.status.title: Status
advisor.settings.error.unreachable: The host did not respond — try again later
